_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score pinned mid-Complacency with flat funding and two-sided skew; 10% coil base rate means HOLD until a same-direction impulse clears the band.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase or direction call (commodity print only).
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54 with funding near flat and no sustained ETF inflow/outflow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G leaves 47-54 on same-direction impulse (below 46 with negative funding/exchange inflows, or above 55 with rising funding and ETF inflows)
